style.name: Rinpa
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #121: Rinpa / 琳派. Build nine distinct premium editorial scenes with gold-or-silver ground, bold seasonal flowers, grasses, birds, water currents and cloud shapes, simplified decorative contours, luminous mineral pigments, asymmetric balance and large intentional negative space. Translate every modern news subject into a complete Rinpa-inspired scene rather than a generic poster template, repeated cards or a dashboard. Keep copy on calm low-texture fields with strong contrast; reduce information density by about 20%, emphasize one conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 readable modules, with large type, generous line spacing and breathing room. News scenes, evidence and infographics occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central flowing gold-ground world-stage, using curving streams, cloud bands, folding-screen rhythms and layered foreground-background storytelling rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each summary needs a quiet readable field, clear 1-8 order and no extra event. Chinese and English keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and artwork filling all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: 开放模型、单人工具、AI影像收入、跨境服装、埃博拉防线、亚马逊火情、社会包容与粮食创新进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月16日全球经营雷达；开放模型、单人工具、AI影像收入、跨境服装、埃博拉防线、亚马逊火情、社会包容与粮食创新进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. 瑞士AI团队发布Apertus 1.5技术说明，8B与70B开放模型新增图像和音频理解、思考模式、26.2万上下文及更强工具调用。
2. Screenshot to Code由Abi Raja一人运营，把截图、设计稿和录屏转成前端代码，Stripe验证累计收入260054美元、MRR 4783美元。
3. Boothie把自拍重绘成胶片、数码相机和复古影棚风格，以周订阅和点数包验证累计收入143960美元、MRR 50264美元。
4. 英国户外服饰品牌Passenger从约50万美元增长到超过1亿美元GMV，跨境销售占比两年内从不足1%升至40%。
5. 肯尼亚确认第二例Bundibugyo埃博拉病例，患者是首例死亡病例的亲属，在隔离期间被发现且暂无社区传播证据。
6. 亚马逊火点自巴西首轮大选后增加约三倍，政府调查人为纵火线索，烟霾已扰乱马瑙斯学校与公共生活。
7. 联合国《世界社会报告2026》提出把社会包容视为数字、绿色与经济转型的前置投资，并指出27%的15至24岁年轻女性未就业、未就学或未培训。
8. 2026年世界粮食日以“创新当下，粮安未来”为主题，提醒全球仍约有6.73亿人挨饿、26亿人负担不起健康膳食。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是让开放能力、商业验证与公共风险都落到可衡量的行动上。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先区分实收、估算与公共目标，再决定下一步。

en-US.headlineView: Open models, a solo developer tool, AI-photo revenue, cross-border apparel, Ebola containment, Amazon fires, social inclusion and food innovation enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 16 Global Operator Radar; Open models, a solo developer tool, AI-photo revenue, cross-border apparel, Ebola containment, Amazon fires, social inclusion and food innovation enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. Swiss AI published Apertus 1.5 release details, adding image and audio understanding, thinking mode, a 262K context window and stronger tool use to open 8B and 70B models.
2. Abi Raja runs Screenshot to Code alone, turning screenshots, mockups and recordings into front-end code while Stripe verifies $260,054 total revenue and $4,783 MRR.
3. Boothie restyles selfies into film, compact-camera and vintage-booth looks, using weekly subscriptions and credit packs to verify $143,960 total revenue and $50,264 MRR.
4. UK outdoor brand Passenger grew from about $500,000 to more than $100 million GMV as cross-border sales rose from under 1% to 40% in two years.
5. Kenya confirmed a second Bundibugyo Ebola case, a relative of the first fatal case who was detected in quarantine, with no evidence of community spread.
6. Amazon fire counts roughly tripled after Brazil's first election round as authorities investigate deliberate ignition and smoke disrupts schools and daily life in Manaus.
7. The UN World Social Report 2026 frames inclusion as upfront investment in digital, green and economic transitions and says 27% of women aged 15-24 are not in employment, education or training.
8. World Food Day 2026 carries the theme “Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow.” while roughly 673 million people still face hunger and 2.6 billion cannot afford a healthy diet.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is to turn open capability, commercial proof and public risk into measurable action.
en-US.doudouQuote: Separate collected revenue, estimates and public targets before choosing the next move.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Apertus 1.5把开放模型扩展到图像与音频
zh-CN.headlineView: 8B和70B版本新增思考模式、26.2万上下文与更强工具调用，并公开权重、数据、价值准则和训练细节
zh-CN.headlineFull: Apertus 1.5把开放模型扩展到图像与音频；8B和70B版本新增思考模式、26.2万上下文与更强工具调用，并公开权重、数据、价值准则和训练细节
zh-CN.intro: 瑞士AI团队10月15日发布Apertus 1.5技术说明。8B与70B模型可把图像和音频与文本作为同一序列中的离散token输入，理解文档、图表、照片与实验性语音，但只生成文本；上下文窗口扩展到262144 token，并加入可切换的思考模式、指令遵循与工具使用训练。项目在Apertus 1.0基础上继续训练，8B加入4万亿token、70B加入2万亿token，并公开权重、数据来源、训练配方、阶段检查点与可复现实验。团队承认其整体表现仍落后于前沿开放权重模型；真正优势是透明、可审计与可本地部署，而不是单靠榜单数字宣称领先。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 开放模型的竞争力，不只在分数，也在别人能否复查它如何被做出来。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 26.2万上下文和多模态很实用，但部署成本与真实任务评测仍要自己算。

en-US.headlineFact: Apertus 1.5 extends open models to images and audio
en-US.headlineView: The 8B and 70B releases add thinking mode, a 262K context window and stronger tool use while publishing weights, data, values and training details
en-US.headlineFull: Apertus 1.5 extends open models to images and audio; The 8B and 70B releases add thinking mode, a 262K context window and stronger tool use while publishing weights, data, values and training details
en-US.intro: Swiss AI published Apertus 1.5 release details on October 15. The 8B and 70B models can accept images and audio as discrete tokens in the same sequence as text, understanding documents, charts, photos and experimental speech while generating text only. The context window grows to 262,144 tokens, with optional thinking mode and improved instruction following and tool use. Continued training added 4 trillion tokens to the 8B model and 2 trillion to the 70B model. Weights, data sources, recipes, intermediate checkpoints and reproducible evaluations are public. The team says overall performance still trails frontier open-weight models; the distinctive value is transparency, auditability and local deployment rather than a claim of benchmark dominance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An open model competes not only on scores but on whether others can inspect how it was made.
en-US.doudouQuote: A 262K window and multimodality help, but deployment cost and real-task evaluation still belong to you.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Screenshot to Code一人运营，验证MRR 4783美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 用8万星开源项目持续导流，把截图、设计稿和录屏转前端代码的托管版做成约300个订阅
zh-CN.headlineFull: Screenshot to Code一人运营，验证MRR 4783美元；用8万星开源项目持续导流，把截图、设计稿和录屏转前端代码的托管版做成约300个订阅
zh-CN.intro: Screenshot to Code由Abi Raja一人运营，面向前端开发者、设计师、自由职业者和独立创始人，把截图、设计稿、短录屏或文字描述转成HTML、Tailwind、React、Vue等可编辑前端代码，再用自然语言迭代。TrustMRR通过Stripe验证累计收入260054美元、MRR 4783美元和314个活跃订阅，10月15日更新；Hobby与Pro方案为每月15美元和40美元。获客杠杆来自保持公开的8万星开源仓库，它带来稳定自然流量；创始人自报约25.8万注册用户、每周运营不足2小时、过去12个月利润率60%。这是可核验收入加创始人自报经营数据，限制在模型调用成本、输出质量、开源替代品与单人维护风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 把开源信任变成托管便利，是一人公司可以长期复利的分发结构。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: MRR由Stripe验证，利润率与工时仍是创始人自报。

en-US.headlineFact: Solo-run Screenshot to Code verifies $4,783 MRR
en-US.headlineView: An 80K-star open-source project provides steady acquisition while the hosted screenshot-to-front-end service supports roughly 300 subscriptions
en-US.headlineFull: Solo-run Screenshot to Code verifies $4,783 MRR; An 80K-star open-source project provides steady acquisition while the hosted screenshot-to-front-end service supports roughly 300 subscriptions
en-US.intro: Abi Raja operates Screenshot to Code alone for front-end developers, designers, freelancers and indie founders. It turns screenshots, mockups, short recordings or text prompts into editable HTML, Tailwind, React, Vue and other front-end code, then accepts natural-language refinements. TrustMRR verifies through Stripe $260,054 in total revenue, $4,783 MRR and 314 active subscriptions, updated October 15; Hobby and Pro plans cost $15 and $40 monthly. Its acquisition leverage is the public 80K-star open-source repository, which feeds steady organic traffic into the hosted service. The founder reports about 258,000 registered users, under two hours of weekly operations and a 60% trailing-12-month margin. Revenue is independently connected, while margin and workload are founder-reported; model cost, output quality, open-source substitutes and solo maintenance remain the limits.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Turning open-source trust into hosted convenience gives a solo company a compounding distribution structure.
en-US.doudouQuote: Stripe verifies the MRR; margin and weekly workload remain founder-reported.

sources.title: Screenshot to Code verified revenue profile

zh-CN.headlineView: 把自拍重绘成胶片、数码相机与复古影棚风格，以周订阅、每日点数和额外点数包在iOS与Android变现
zh-CN.headlineFull: Boothie验证MRR 50264美元；把自拍重绘成胶片、数码相机与复古影棚风格，以周订阅、每日点数和额外点数包在iOS与Android变现
zh-CN.intro: Boothie面向16至40岁、常在TikTok和Instagram发图的女性用户：选择Canon G7X数码感、Kodak Gold胶片、复古照相亭或夜间闪光等风格，上传自拍后由AI快速重绘；免费本地滤镜承担试用，AI生成通过Plus、Gold周订阅的每日点数和额外点数包收费。TrustMRR通过RevenueCat验证累计收入143960美元、MRR 50264美元和2152个活跃订阅，数据于10月15日更新；应用6月上线iOS、9月上线Android。创始人自报早期依靠美国、德国和土耳其近十个TikTok人格账号的轮播内容获客且未投付费广告。结果证明移动端视觉玩法能付费，但留存、生成成本、平台抽成、内容账号依赖和风格同质化决定利润。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI影像赚钱，不是堆模型名，而是把一个想晒出来的结果压缩到几秒。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 50264美元MRR验证了付费，留存和每次生成毛利才决定能否长跑。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineView: It restyles selfies into film, compact-camera and vintage-booth looks, monetizing on iOS and Android through weekly subscriptions, daily credits and credit packs
en-US.headlineFull: Boothie verifies $50,264 MRR; It restyles selfies into film, compact-camera and vintage-booth looks, monetizing on iOS and Android through weekly subscriptions, daily credits and credit packs
en-US.intro: Boothie targets women aged 16 to 40 who post on TikTok and Instagram. A user selects a Canon G7X-style digital look, Kodak Gold film, vintage photobooth, night flash or another aesthetic, uploads a selfie and receives an AI restyle. Free local filters provide the trial layer; AI generations monetize through daily credits in Plus and Gold weekly subscriptions plus extra credit packs. TrustMRR verifies through RevenueCat $143,960 in total revenue, $50,264 MRR and 2,152 active subscriptions, updated October 15. The app launched on iOS in June and Android in September. The founder reports that early acquisition came from almost a dozen TikTok persona accounts across the US, Germany and Türkiye without paid ads. Paid demand is proven, while retention, generation cost, store fees, channel dependence and visual sameness determine profit.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI imagery earns when a share-worthy result is compressed into a few seconds, not when model names are stacked up.
en-US.doudouQuote: $50,264 MRR proves payment; retention and gross margin per generation decide endurance.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Passenger跨境销售占比两年从不足1%升至40%
zh-CN.headlineView: 户外服饰品牌用单店多市场、本地化结账与多币种留存降低复杂度，四年GMV从约50万美元增至超过1亿美元
zh-CN.headlineFull: Passenger跨境销售占比两年从不足1%升至40%；户外服饰品牌用单店多市场、本地化结账与多币种留存降低复杂度，四年GMV从约50万美元增至超过1亿美元
zh-CN.intro: 英国户外服饰品牌Passenger销售强调耐用与负责任面料的服装，Shopify案例称其GMV四年内从约50万美元增长到超过1亿美元，跨境销售占收入比例又在两年内从不足1%升至40%。它没有为每个国家拆分独立商店，而是在单一后台快速测试约10个市场，并针对美国和德国调整语言、配送方式、结账措辞与营销投入；多币种收款让美元和欧元销售款直接支付全球供应商，减少先换英镑再换回外币的双重汇兑。赚钱机制是全球户外消费需求加本地化转化和更高支付授权率，主要成本与风险是库存、退货、物流、市场投放、汇率和供应链，所有结果均为商家向Shopify提供。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境增长的捷径不是多开店，而是先让结账、库存与资金流像一个系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 1亿美元是GMV，真正利润还要扣库存、退货、物流和获客。

en-US.headlineFact: Passenger grew cross-border sales from under 1% to 40% in two years
en-US.headlineView: The outdoor brand used one store, localized checkout and multi-currency balances to reduce complexity as GMV rose from about $500,000 to more than $100 million in four years
en-US.headlineFull: Passenger grew cross-border sales from under 1% to 40% in two years; The outdoor brand used one store, localized checkout and multi-currency balances to reduce complexity as GMV rose from about $500,000 to more than $100 million in four years
en-US.intro: UK outdoor apparel brand Passenger sells durable clothing with an emphasis on responsible materials. A Shopify case study says GMV grew from about $500,000 to more than $100 million in four years, while cross-border sales moved from under 1% to 40% of revenue in two years. Instead of splitting every country into a separate store, Passenger tested roughly ten markets from one backend and localized language, shipping methods, checkout wording and marketing for the US and Germany. Multi-currency payouts let it keep dollars and euros from sales to pay global suppliers, reducing the double foreign-exchange cost of converting into pounds and back. The earning mechanism combines global outdoor demand, localized conversion and higher payment authorization; inventory, returns, logistics, acquisition, FX and supply-chain risk remain the main costs. Results were supplied by the merchant to Shopify.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The shortcut to cross-border growth is not more stores but one system for checkout, inventory and cash flow.
en-US.doudouQuote: $100 million is GMV; profit still subtracts inventory, returns, logistics and acquisition.

sources.title: Passenger Grows Cross-Border Revenue Mix from 1% to 40% in Two Years

zh-CN.headlineFact: 肯尼亚确认第二例Bundibugyo埃博拉病例
zh-CN.headlineView: 患者是首例死亡病例的39岁亲属，在隔离期间出现症状并被快速确诊，目前暂无社区传播证据
zh-CN.headlineFull: 肯尼亚确认第二例Bundibugyo埃博拉病例；患者是首例死亡病例的39岁亲属，在隔离期间出现症状并被快速确诊，目前暂无社区传播证据
zh-CN.intro: 肯尼亚卫生部门10月15日确认第二例Bundibugyo埃博拉病例。患者为39岁男性，是该国首例病例的近亲；首例患者曾从刚果（金）经乌干达到内罗毕，10月5日确诊后死亡。第二名患者此前已被列为密切接触者并隔离，出现症状后接受检测，因此更早进入治疗。官方称约128名接触者已被识别，其中108人在隔离，5人位于境外并已通知相关国家；截至通报时，两例有明确流行病学联系，暂无社区传播证据。埃博拉不是空气传播，而是通过患者或遗体的血液和体液直接接触传播，防线取决于接触者追踪、隔离、医疗机构感染控制与跨境信息协作。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 第二例最重要的信息，是它在已知接触链和隔离体系内被发现。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 暂无社区传播不等于零风险，接触者追踪必须完整走完。

en-US.headlineFact: Kenya confirms a second Bundibugyo Ebola case
en-US.headlineView: The 39-year-old relative of the first fatal patient developed symptoms in quarantine and was diagnosed quickly, with no evidence of community transmission
en-US.headlineFull: Kenya confirms a second Bundibugyo Ebola case; The 39-year-old relative of the first fatal patient developed symptoms in quarantine and was diagnosed quickly, with no evidence of community transmission
en-US.intro: Kenyan health authorities confirmed the country's second Bundibugyo Ebola case on October 15. The 39-year-old man is a close relative of Kenya's first case, who travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo through Uganda to Nairobi and died after testing positive on October 5. The second patient had already been identified as a contact and quarantined, allowing testing and treatment soon after symptoms appeared. Officials said roughly 128 contacts had been identified, 108 were in quarantine and five were outside Kenya with the relevant countries notified. The two cases have a clear epidemiological link and there was no evidence of community spread at the time of the update. Ebola is not airborne; it spreads through direct contact with blood or body fluids, making tracing, isolation, clinical infection control and cross-border coordination the core defences.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The critical fact in the second case is that it was found inside a known contact chain and quarantine system.
en-US.doudouQuote: No community spread is not zero risk; the full contact-monitoring period still matters.

sources.title: Kenya records second Ebola case as outbreak in Congo keeps growing

zh-CN.headlineFact: 亚马逊火点在巴西首轮大选后增加约三倍
zh-CN.headlineView: 政府调查是否存在政治动机纵火，干旱与厄尔尼诺则让森林更易燃，马瑙斯烟霾已冲击学校和公共生活
zh-CN.headlineFull: 亚马逊火点在巴西首轮大选后增加约三倍；政府调查是否存在政治动机纵火，干旱与厄尔尼诺则让森林更易燃，马瑙斯烟霾已冲击学校和公共生活
zh-CN.intro: 巴西亚马逊雨林近期火点快速增加。美联社10月15日报道，自10月4日巴西总统选举首轮投票后，生物群系内火点约增至此前三倍；环境部长表示已有迹象指向预谋纵火，联邦与州机构正在调查，但个别火灾原因仍待证据确认。与此同时，厄尔尼诺伴随的干旱降低了森林湿度，卫星在马瑙斯和圣塔伦周边看到密集烟羽。马瑙斯空气污染已迫使学校停课、公共活动取消并影响超过200万居民。政治调查不能替代气候事实，气候条件也不能证明每场火灾的点火者；当前行动应同时覆盖执法取证、禁火管理、空气健康预警和长期森林保护。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 火灾风险来自可燃的森林，也来自决定是否点火的人。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先分清气候放大器与人为点火证据，才能对症行动。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与环境。

en-US.headlineFact: Amazon fire counts roughly tripled after Brazil's first election round
en-US.headlineView: Authorities are investigating possible politically motivated ignition while drought and El Niño leave forests more combustible and smoke disrupts schools and public life in Manaus
en-US.headlineFull: Amazon fire counts roughly tripled after Brazil's first election round; Authorities are investigating possible politically motivated ignition while drought and El Niño leave forests more combustible and smoke disrupts schools and public life in Manaus
en-US.intro: Fire activity has surged across Brazil's Amazon rainforest. The Associated Press reported on October 15 that fire counts in the biome roughly tripled after the first round of Brazil's presidential election on October 4. The environment minister said indications point to a deliberate effort to start fires, and federal and state agencies are investigating, though the cause of individual fires still requires evidence. At the same time, El Niño-linked drought has lowered forest moisture and satellites have observed dense smoke around Manaus and Santarém. Pollution in Manaus has closed schools, cancelled public events and affected a city of more than two million people. The political investigation does not replace the climate evidence, and climate conditions do not identify who lit each fire; action must combine enforcement, burn controls, health alerts and long-term forest protection.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Fire risk comes from combustible forest conditions and from human decisions about ignition.
en-US.doudouQuote: Separate the climate amplifier from evidence of deliberate ignition so each response fits the cause.

sources.title: Brazil investigates Amazon wildfires disrupting daily life, fueled political attacks

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国要求把社会包容从补救项变成前置投资
zh-CN.headlineView: 《世界社会报告2026》警告数字、绿色与经济转型若忽视技能、服务和保障，会把效率收益转化为更高排斥成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国要求把社会包容从补救项变成前置投资；《世界社会报告2026》警告数字、绿色与经济转型若忽视技能、服务和保障，会把效率收益转化为更高排斥成本
zh-CN.intro: 联合国经济和社会事务部发布《世界社会报告2026：社会包容新经济学》，把包容定义为成功转型的前提，而不是增长完成后的补偿。报告指出，全球仍有数十亿人无法获得参与数字化、绿色与经济转型所需的工作、技能、基础服务、基础设施和社会保护；15至24岁年轻女性中有27%未就业、未就学或未接受培训。其核心主张是把教育、数字接入、普惠金融、社会保障、无障碍基础设施与劳动力转岗同时写入投资项目，因为延后包容会形成可测量的经济损失。报告提供全球政策框架而非单个国家的收益承诺，执行仍取决于财政能力、数据质量、地方参与和问责。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 转型若先排除一部分人，后来花更多钱修补也补不回失去的机会。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 包容不是口号，要在预算、技能、基础设施和结果指标里同时出现。

en-US.headlineFact: The UN says social inclusion must move from repair cost to upfront investment
en-US.headlineView: The World Social Report 2026 warns that digital, green and economic transitions can turn efficiency gains into exclusion costs when skills, services and protection are missing
en-US.headlineFull: The UN says social inclusion must move from repair cost to upfront investment; The World Social Report 2026 warns that digital, green and economic transitions can turn efficiency gains into exclusion costs when skills, services and protection are missing
en-US.intro: The UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs released The World Social Report 2026: The New Economics of Social Inclusion, defining inclusion as a precondition for successful transformation rather than compensation after growth. Billions still lack the jobs, skills, essential services, infrastructure and protection needed to benefit from digital, green and economic change; 27% of young women aged 15 to 24 are not in employment, education or training. The report argues that education, digital access, inclusive finance, social protection, accessible infrastructure and worker transitions should be designed into investment from the start because delayed inclusion creates measurable economic losses. It is a global policy framework, not a promised return for any one country; delivery still depends on fiscal capacity, reliable data, local participation and accountability.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When transformation excludes people first, later repair spending cannot restore every lost opportunity.
en-US.doudouQuote: Inclusion becomes real only when it appears in budgets, skills, infrastructure and outcome metrics together.

sources.title: Rethinking inclusion: From afterthought to foundation

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界粮食日呼吁“创新当下，粮安未来”
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球仍约有6.73亿人挨饿、26亿人负担不起健康膳食，创新必须从实验室走到农田、市场、金融与物流
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界粮食日呼吁“创新当下，粮安未来”；全球仍约有6.73亿人挨饿、26亿人负担不起健康膳食，创新必须从实验室走到农田、市场、金融与物流
zh-CN.intro: 10月16日世界粮食日以“创新当下，粮安未来”为主题。联合国粮农组织指出，全球拥有足以生产充足食物的能力，但冲突、经济冲击、气候压力与分配缺口仍让约6.73亿人挨饿、26亿人无力负担健康膳食。这里的创新不只指AI或生物技术，也包括改良种子、数字化农技服务、数据系统、农民田间学校、传统水土管理、合作社、金融和物流新模式；关键是技术被采用、适应、融资并扩大到真正需要的人。2026世界粮食论坛把青年行动、科学创新与投资配对放在同一平台。当天主题提供行动方向而非短期减饥结果，成效要看营养可负担性、小农收益、损耗减少和抗冲击能力。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 粮食创新的终点不是一个演示，而是一顿更多人买得起的健康饭。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 从试点到规模，中间还隔着融资、物流、政策和农民收益。

en-US.headlineFact: World Food Day calls to “Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow.”
en-US.headlineView: Roughly 673 million people still face hunger and 2.6 billion cannot afford a healthy diet, so innovation must travel from laboratories into farms, markets, finance and logistics
en-US.headlineFull: World Food Day calls to “Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow.”; Roughly 673 million people still face hunger and 2.6 billion cannot afford a healthy diet, so innovation must travel from laboratories into farms, markets, finance and logistics
en-US.intro: World Food Day on October 16 carries the theme “Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow.” FAO says the world has the capacity to produce enough food, yet conflict, economic shocks, climate pressure and distribution gaps still leave roughly 673 million people hungry and 2.6 billion unable to afford a healthy diet. Innovation here is broader than AI or biotechnology: it includes improved seeds, digital advisory services, data systems, farmer field schools, traditional soil and water management, cooperatives, finance and new logistics. The decisive step is adoption, adaptation, funding and scale for the people who need the solution. The 2026 World Food Forum joins youth action, science and innovation with investment matchmaking. The theme is an action direction rather than a short-term hunger result; progress must be measured through diet affordability, smallholder income, lower loss and stronger resilience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Food innovation ends not in a demo but in a healthy meal that more people can afford.
en-US.doudouQuote: Between pilot and scale sit finance, logistics, policy and the producer's own return.

sources.title: World Food Forum 2026 opens under Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow
